literal_meaning: অঙ্কে থাকা লক্ষ্মী (lap-dwelling Lakshmi) or অঙ্কে শোয়া নারী (woman who sleeps in the lap)
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার অঙ্কলক্ষ্মী তার জীবনের সবচেয়ে বড় সম্পদ।
অঙ্কশায়িনী হিসেবে সে তার স্বামীর সব দুঃখ ভুলিয়ে দেয়।
example_sentences_in_english: His ankalkakshmi is the greatest treasure in his life.
As his ankashayini, she makes him forget all his sorrows.
history: This term draws from Hindu mythology where Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth and prosperity, is depicted as residing in the lap of her consort Vishnu, symbolizing an ideal wife who brings fortune and comfort.
note: An archaic and poetic term used in Bengali literature to affectionately refer to one's wife, emphasizing her role as a source of prosperity and intimacy.
